selection_basis: Rectangles chosen by visual inspection of the original source images and the independently prepared Phase A reference; detector output was not consulted.

coordinate_system.rectangle: x, y, width, height; right/bottom are exclusive

crop_encoding: PNG encoded from the decoded source pixels; lossless relative to the decoded raster

test2.jpg.selection_note: Bottom/fourth rough sketch plus margin, selected from the source image because it is the most isolated page region. The reference annotation remains ambiguous; no accuracy metrics are authorized.

test5.png.selection_note: Exactly the independently annotated Phase A main-truss evaluation ROI, which encloses the full eight-joint, sixteen-member graph.
